"SFJ hereby grants to PB a ... license"

Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: No express retention of Customer Data rights; Research Results are "Confidential Information of PB" only, and SFJ owns the data package
Clause is silent on joint ownership; sole ownership vests in SFJ pending sale

reasons: The inserted sentence completes every atomic element of the fallback: SFJ retains its generic tools and know-how, and PB receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Trial Data Package and Research Results for its business.

Preferred is not achieved and was not targeted: SFJ remains sole owner of the Trial Data Package until the later purchase, there is no present assignment of deliverables to PB, and there is no express retention of Customer Data rights or no-joint-ownership statement.

The edit is a single concise insertion into a clause that lacked any licence-back; unrelated terms (Approval Payments, Exhibit K purchase mechanic, confidentiality deeming provisions) are untouched and remain effective.

Minor point noted, not a deviation: "such license shall survive any expiration or termination of this Agreement" is largely covered by "perpetual, irrevocable", but it removes any argument that the licence dies with the Agreement's termination trigger in 11.1.1.4(B), so it is defensible rather than surplus.
Margin comment accurately describes the operative change and cites the playbook position without overclaiming.
